name: Intermittent capability workload
prompt: Design an Agent system that handles changing task families with a maximum of four retained behavior capsules and at most two simultaneous tool calls. The arrival mix sometimes repeats an old family and sometimes introduces a new one. Workers may stop between tasks. Every task needs a checkable output receipt. Minimize total paid work, startup cost and state maintenance while preserving correctness. Assume a local sandbox with replayable input traces and no external irreversible actions. Specify how state is stored, selected, invalidated and reconstructed. You may choose centralized, distributed or hybrid control; justify it against the constraints.

name: Shared evidence work under disruption
prompt: Design an Agent system that maintains a small shared evidence collection for twelve concurrent research requests. Documents and tool endpoints can become stale or temporarily unavailable. The total tool-call and storage budgets are fixed. Multiple agents can produce duplicate or contradictory findings. Each delivered answer must link to the exact evidence version used. Reduce redundant work and recover from partial worker failure without silently promoting unverified claims. Assume simulated documents, simulated tools and no external messaging. Specify conflict handling, resource allocation, recovery, state transitions and a reproducible evaluation. You may choose any control topology.
